glossEn: the state of matter distinguished from the solid and liquid states by: relatively low density and viscosity; relatively great expansion and contraction with changes in pressure and temperature; the ability to diffuse readily; and the spontaneous tendency to become distributed uniformly throughout any container / a fluid in the gaseous state having neither independent shape nor volume and being able to expand indefinitely
note: the state of matter distinguished from the solid and liquid / a fluid in the gaseous state。线索：a gas / gas mask。抽象物质状态与具体气体，中文统一译「气体」，合并。
